newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia seizes Power Rangers goods.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia seizes Power Rangers goods.

text.p: Malaysian authorities seized watches, toys and other goods inspired by the Power Rangers children's show, saying the show's catch-phrase -- "it's morphin time" -- could encourage drug use.

The Domestic Trade and Consumer Affairs Ministry enforcement division confiscated 337 Power Rangers watches and 747 items including toys, key chains, coin boxes and stationery bearing the offending phrase, the national Bernama news agency reported late on Wednesday.
The items were taken from 34 shops out of 568 checked in a two-day nationwide operation which began on Monday, it said.

The Power Rangers' refrain refers to the metamorphosis the characters undergo to change from mortals to superheroes. But enforcement division director Abdul Jabar Kamin said the words "it's morphin time" could influence children to get hooked on drugs, Bernama reported.
Malaysia has strict drug laws, requiring the death penalty for anyone caught with 15 grams (0.5 ounces) of heroin or 200 grams (seven ounces) of cannabis.
